title: Governance
description: Container for the governance screen (R8, F3 step 4, A-2). Two lists and a sourced argument. The statements required by L2 are pinned by identifier, so the screen cannot ship without them. Every 'implemented' statement names the test that verifies it, which turns a claim about the demo into a checkable one; that is why the container, and with it both lists, is labelled real (DM-2). The argument is drafted by the Architect during G3 from the Scout's frozen regulatory source list (Q-5 outcome, 5 Oct 2026), so every argument paragraph carries its own required label, fixed to ai-generated, and at least one dated source. Shipped in data/governance.js.

argument.description: What own-data ingestion would require before it could be built, as paragraphs in reading order. This is one continuous argument, not a list of peers, so its order is the order of the reasoning. Each paragraph states conditions, not advice (C-6), and cites at least one dated source that the Verifier has opened; a paragraph it cannot tie to a listed source is cut, not softened. If no paragraph passes, the fallback is a single paragraph citing the GDPR's own definition of personal data (gates.md, Q-5).

label.description: Fixed by the Q-5 outcome: machine-written prose is labelled ai-generated (M1-U17).
real: the two lists are statements about the demo, each implemented item backed by a named test (DM-2). The argument paragraphs carry their own label.
